invariants: TLS verify-full is required outside developer mode
key/certificate inputs are opaque handles rather than inline secrets
pool minimum does not exceed maximum
acquire timeout is bounded by idle timeout and maximum lifetime
lock timeout is bounded by statement timeout and transaction timeout
retry deadline is bounded by transaction timeout
automatic retry is limited to read-only, idempotent command and receipt-apply operations
resync-required and never-retry errors stop immediately
attempt and total deadline budgets are finite
